audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 51.78% WR / 1041 games; assassin vs immobile artillery is correctly framed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text, late and wants.foe[2] call his R 'Rite of the Ancients' — real name is Rite of the Arcane.
audit.why: Kit file is the authority on names.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing: Rite of the Arcane is a self-immobilizing channel — Qiyana's Q or R stun cancels it outright. Also 'fifteen-second invitation' for Shocking Orb is wrong: E is 13s at rank 1, 11s max.
audit.corrected: Channel cancel added to report[5]; 13s used in dosFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.

edits.before: Late he's a poke threat from screen-range with Arcanopulse and Rite of the Ancients, so don't walk straight down mid into his barrage. Roam and flank: your W-E mobility lets you reach him from angles his artillery can't defend, and he folds the instant you arrive.
edits.after: Late he's a poke threat from screen-range with Arcanopulse and Rite of the Arcane, so don't walk straight down mid into his barrage. Roam and flank: your W-E mobility lets you reach him from angles his artillery can't defend, and he folds the instant you arrive.

edits.before: His late-game threat is screen-wide poke, not dueling — so never facetank a straight lane approach. Use your mobility to flank from stealth and angles, arrive on top of him past his E, and delete him before Rite of the Ancients matters. Reach him and the fight is already won.
edits.after: His late-game threat is screen-wide poke, not dueling — so never facetank a straight lane approach. Use your mobility to flank from stealth and angles, arrive on top of him past his E, and delete him before Rite of the Arcane matters. Reach him and the fight is already won.

edits.before: Zone you off the wave with long-range Rite of the Ancients
edits.after: Zone you off the wave with long-range Rite of the Arcane

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Terrashape (element swap) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): 13s at rank 1, 11s max — his only CC; dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Step up only on its downtime. - Eye of Destruction cycles on 14s down to 10s. - Budget your W for emergencies and the 120s R for opportunities.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Ice-Q the step-up and E through the root — a rooted Xerath cannot land Shocking Orb, so the trade is free on arrival.

edits.before: Xerath burns Shocking Orb (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Xerath burns Shocking Orb (Stun) on nothing — take the 13-second invitation.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Terrashape is damage and escape in one 7s button — idle swaps leave the all-in unloaded when his E whiffs.

edits.before: Track Xerath’s Shocking Orb (Stun): His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Shocking Orb (Stun, 13s): his only CC — dodge it and the artillery never kills you. His R self-roots to channel; your Q or R stun cancels it.

notes: Level chart agrees across full layer, content layer and packet (all Qiyana) — no chart edits. Fabricated R name 'Rite of the Ancients' corrected to Rite of the Arcane in three places. 'Fifteen-second invitation' magnitude fixed to the real 13s rank-1 E cooldown. Added the channel-cancel interaction (Qiyana Q/R stops Rite of the Arcane) from missingInteractions.
